text:
maria: Customer on EU region reporting partial 401s + huge latency spikes for embeddings and chat endpoints since ~14:05 UTC.
cheng: seeing same in monitoring — traffic for org=acme-eu is hitting us-east backend, RTT ~220ms vs expected ~18ms. :eyes:
paul-sre: any recent routing/deploy changes? can you paste the first failing request headers (redact tokens)?
maria: pasted from support logs:
```
GET /v1/chat/completions
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Client-Region: eu-west-1
X-Forwarded-For: 3.3.3.3
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
```
Response: 401 Authorization failed; proxy logs show upstream host: gpu-us-east-1
cheng: envoy access log snippet (timestamps aligned):
```
172.20.10.5 - - [17/Mar/2026:14:05:12 +0000] "POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "go/1.20" x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 2
172.20.10.6 - - [17/Mar/2026:14:05:13 +0000] "POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1" 503 0 "-" "python-requests/2.31" x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 210
```
cheng: notice the 503 path is going to a different cluster id: cluster/gpu-us-east-fallback
kevin: we rolled a small route normalization change in edge-proxy yesterday that rewrites region hints to a canonical header name, maybe a bug there. deploy-bot: DEPLOY_sha=bb7a1 rolled at 2026-03-16T23:40Z
sara-support: customers also flagged unexpected token billing — they saw per-token billing charged higher because requests egressed cross-region, cc:billing
paul-sre: hypothesis: L7 route rule does header_match on X-Client-Region but the new transform removed it, so fallback policy routes to us-east cluster. Need repro with curl showing header preserved or not.
maria: repro from eu-west VM:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" \
 -H "X-Client-Region: eu-west-1" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-2b","input":"hi"}'
```
Result: 401, and tracing header shows x-rd-region: us-east-1
cheng: ran tcpdump on edge box — original X-Client-Region present on incoming conn, but upstream request header is X-RD-REGION: us-east-1 (uppercased by filter) and X-Client-Region missing.
paul-sre: that matches a header_preserve bug in the header_normalizer filter — when header name canonicalization runs before our region-injector, it drops the original header. Looking at envoy config: route action has `host_rewrite` + `request_headers_to_add` that sets x-rd-region if missing, but missing check fails after canonicalization.
kevin: minimal repro patch:
```
# broken transform pseudo
- name: header_normalizer
  action: canonicalize
- name: region_injector
  action: set_if_missing x-rd-region: "%REQ(X-Client-Region)%"
```
If canonicalize lowercases header keys and region_injector expects exact-case, the guard thinks header exists and returns us-east default.
sara-support: customer impact: increased latency for EU customers, 2x-10x token billing for cross-region egress, and intermittent auth failures (because auth cluster uses different keyset).
paul-sre: mitigation: revert deploy or add a safe check in region_injector to read case-insensitive header names. Also add a short-lived traffic-steer rule to enforce region affinity by source CIDR while we patch.
cheng: quick firewall steer applied to pin org=acme-eu to eu pool at 14:17 UTC — latency back to ~25ms on sampled requests.
maria: sending customer note: "we identified gateway header normalization bug causing region hints to be lost; we've applied a temporary steer and are patching the proxy. We'll follow up with root cause and billing remediation." :white_check_mark:
kevin: proposed fix (PR): region_injector: read headers case-insensitively and prefer X-Client-Region > X-Forwarded-Region > computed geo. added unit tests and an e2e that asserts header preservation through header_normalizer.
paul-sre: also add an observability check: count requests where incoming X-Client-Region != upstream x-rd-region and fire alert if >0.1% for 5m.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK_START DEPLOY_sha=bb7a1 by kevin at 2026-03-17T14:25Z
opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-0317-01 (priority P2) — assigned to paul-sre, kevin, cheng
sara-support: customer asked about billing — raised billing ticket to investigate cross-region egress charges, cc finance.
maria: will coordinate postmortem and customer bill adjustments after RCA. thanks all for quick response.
kevin: PR merged and canary applied, monitoring shows no region mismatch after 10m. keep an eye. :thumbsup:
paul-sre: closing thread for now, will add to postmortems folder. if anything suspicious ping #eng-oncall.
